quote: TOOLMAKER generates an executable tool that enables LLMs to perform the task...
We introduce TOOLMAKER, a framework that autonomously transforms scientific code repositories into LLM-compatible tools...
outputs: Generated Python functions and Docker containers for scientific tasks
Python functions that implement scientific tasks by integrating existing code repositories

quote: TM-BENCH includes over 100 unit tests to objectively assess the generated tools' correctness...

We consider a tool implementation correct only if it passes all unit tests of its test invocations. ... ToolMAKER significantly outperforms Open-Hands, achieving an accuracy of 80% (correctly implementing 12/15 tasks).

We employ unit tests to verify correctness through assertions on: structure (dimensions and types of return values), values (range, accuracy, and statistical properties of return values), files (existence, format, and content of files produced by the tool, if applicable), and execution (errors/crashes).
